Public surfaces, findings, severities, and incomplete status are unchanged. Reviewed strict grammar recovery against the pinned sources: valid variance modifiers, reserved-word export aliases and anonymous default declaration signatures retain their public evidence. Each version now resolves all 49 locale default declarations plus their index barrel. This adds 300 previously empty wildcard/synthetic declaration contexts and eight aggregate declaration contexts, and removes exactly 98 unresolved-locale warnings across both versions. Six runtime import contexts gain recovered reserved-word aliases; direct Node imports confirm null/function/instanceof/catch/void names and the v3 runtime count of 109. All 31 additional export-deprecated Warnings were checked against adjacent @deprecated comments at their recorded declarations, including formerly missed export-declare wrappers and the recovered kh/ua default declarations. All 59 additional analysis-incomplete Warnings concern custom @zod/source entries whose literal .js imports have no source-tree file; each named source path and missing target was checked and each corresponding native Node request fails ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. No previous finding is lost, no new Major is emitted, both versions have identical surface gains, and structural-only exit 3 remains unchanged.
